Callout.Name: Shots Fired - Residential
Callout.Message: Several shots heard on a residential street.
Callout.Advisory: No victim found by the caller, nobody answering doors.

Script.Line: It was four or five. It came from the alley.
I put the lights out and got on the floor, like you are told.
I have not been outside. I am not going outside.

Lines.Approach: Four or five shots, no victim yet, and nobody is answering their door.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
